summary.text: Steven Galloway is the Republican candidate for the Montana State Senate, District 11, in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
A business owner, he previously represented District 24 in the Montana House of Representatives from January 2021 to January 2025.

paragraphs.text: Steven Galloway was born in Great Falls, Montana, and graduated from CMR High School in 1977.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as owning and operating businesses.
Galloway assumed office in the Montana House on January 4, 2021, and left office on January 6, 2025.

Ballotpedia lists him on the House Local Government, Natural Resources, and Business and Labor committees in 2021-2022, and on the Business and Labor, Energy, Technology, and Federal Relations (as vice chair), and Local Government committees in 2023-2024.
